item.title: U.S. January wholesale prices arrive hotter than expected
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) – U.S. wholesale prices came in hotter than expected last month. The Labor Department reported Friday that its producer price index, which measures inflation before it hits consumers, rose 0.5% from December and 2.9% from January 2025.
